hero.title: Play Sail solo, with a silent Bosun.
hero.lead: A free phone companion for Chuck Rosselli's Sail Solitaire. The Bosun takes the other side of the ship: you flip its cards, and the app keeps the tricks, the Kraken and the storms.
hero.note: Free · works offline · no account · 5 languages

companion.title: A companion, not a digital game
companion.lead: Sail stays on your table. The app only does what's fiddly when you play alone.

table.title: On your table
items: The ocean board, the ship and the scenario's tokens
Every card: your hand, both decks and the discard pile
The Bosun's face-down stack of nine

app.title: In the app
items: How the Bosun plays each trick
The order for every pair of symbols
The Kraken deck: when its card comes up, and what it costs
Storm checks, the rounds and your captain's log

get.title: You need Sail itself
get.lead: Bosun is a fan-made helper. Get the game from its publisher or a shop near you, and support the people who made it.

publisher.text: The publisher of Sail, with the rules and where to buy it.

shop.title: A shop near you
shop.text: A store picked for this page's language, named, with the edition it sells.

bgg.text: Sail, its forums, and Sail Solitaire by Chuck Rosselli.

how.title: How a voyage goes
how.lead: Set up as the rulebook says, then let the app run the Bosun one trick at a time.

steps.title: Pick a scenario and a difficulty
steps.text: Easy shares two Pirate cards, Medium gives the Bosun its own, Hard gives it none.

steps.title: Tick the table setup
steps.text: Nine lines from the rulebook and the variant. Set sail waits until every one is done.

steps.title: Play the trick
steps.text: The app says how the Bosun plays: flip until your colour shows, or lead with its top card.

steps.title: Tap the winner and the symbols
steps.text: You get the order: where the ship goes, and how often the Kraken attacks.

features.title: Everything the paper rules ask you to remember

combo.title: Every combo, resolved
combo.text: Helm, kraken, tail and cannon pairs, turned into a move and its attacks.

kraken.title: The Kraken deck, counted
kraken.text: It knows when the Kraken card comes up, and what the round's end will cost.

storms.title: Storms and rounds
storms.text: The storm checks after rounds II and IV, and who leads each round.

undo.title: Undo any tap
undo.text: A slip at the table is one tap to fix; the ship's log shows every step.

offline.title: Offline, installable, awake
offline.text: Install it to your home screen. It works without a network and keeps the screen on.

log.title: Captain's log
log.text: Wins and tries for every scenario at every difficulty, kept on your phone.

languages.title: Five languages
languages.lead: English, Spanish, German, Russian and Serbian in Cyrillic. The app follows your phone, and you can switch at any time. The translations are mostly AI: corrections are welcome.

install.title: Install it, or host your own

phone.title: On your phone
phone.iphone: iPhone: open it in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
phone.android: Android and desktop Chrome: tap Install on the card on Home.

host.title: Your own copy
host.text: It's a static app with no server: run the Docker image, or deploy the repository to Vercel.

game.label: THE GAME
game.text: Sail by Akiyama Koryo and Kozu Yusei, illustrated by Weberson Santiago, published by Allplay.

variant.label: THE SOLO VARIANT
variant.text: Sail Solitaire by Chuck Rosselli, on BoardGameGeek.

app.label: THIS APP

credits.privacy: No cookies, no accounts. Your voyages stay on your phone.
